title: The Three Lives Pact
next_chapter_hook: Su Qingyao is trapped in the Ancient Forbidden Land, her life uncertain. Chen Ji must make a choice between the Imperial Capital and the Forbidden Land, as the Heavenly Eye's gaze quietly draws near.

text.content: When the Demonic Path Commander uttered the words 'Convergence of Three Realms', the Heavenly Fate Mark in Chen Ji's palm suddenly burned searing hot—that was the signal that the Heavenly Eye was gazing upon this place. The scalding pain was like a branding iron piercing through skin, yet Chen Ji's face remained unruffled, with only a cold glint flickering in the depths of his pupils. He slowly withdrew his right hand, the wide sleeve of his servant robe conveniently covering the burning mark. The Demonic Path Commander—a middle-aged man in black robes—was surveying this 'Waste Disciple' with the gaze of a predator examining prey.

dialogue.content: 'The Convergence of Three Realms... Does Senior mean that the Demon, Monster, and Human Realms will reunite here?'

text.content: The Demonic Path Commander let out a cold laugh, demonic energy surging around him like a tide, weighing down the surrounding air. 'Boy, your petty tricks are utterly useless before this old man. The Tianji Record Fragment... I've set my sights on it.' Upon hearing this, Chen Ji's mouth curved slightly, revealing a playful smile. In this moment, he was no longer the servile废物, but a chess player holding the world in his hands. Standing not far away, Ye Qing witnessed this scene, her heart trembling—she had finally glimpsed the true Chen Ji.

dialogue.content: 'If Senior wants the Tianji Record, that can be arranged. However, this junior has one condition—before the Convergence of Three Realms opens, we observe a temporary ceasefire.'

choice.prompt: The Demonic Path Commander examined Chen Ji—this 'Waste' dared negotiate conditions with him. How would he respond?

choices.text: Reveal the trump card, demonstrate the power of the Tianji Record Fragment
choices.description: Let the Demonic Path Commander witness the true might of this divine artifact, earning respect through absolute strength
choices.visible_reward: Gain temporary reverence from the Demonic Path Commander
choices.risk_hint: Revealing the Tianji Record may attract more covetous eyes

text.content: Chen Ji slowly unfurled his right hand, and the ancient Tianji Record mark in his palm suddenly burst forth with ethereal blue light. The Demonic Path Commander's pupils contracted sharply—the Heavenly Principles contained within that light caused even this Nascent Soul realm expert to feel a pang of heart palpitations. 'This is...' His voice carried an unprecedented tremor.

choices.text: Retreat to advance, use information asymmetry to gain negotiating advantage
choices.description: Don't reveal strength, instead captivate him with secrets the Demonic Path Commander doesn't know
choices.visible_reward: Form an alliance without exposing trump cards
choices.risk_hint: Requires precise grasp of the other party's psychology

text.content: Chen Ji收起光芒，只留下淡淡的笑容。'Senior, do you know that the Heavenly Eye has begun gazing upon this place? If I die, the Tianji Record will automatically return to Heavenly karma. Are you certain you wish to make an enemy of Heaven before the Convergence of Three Realms?' The Demonic Path Commander's expression turned as gloomy as water. After a long while, he coldly huffed: 'Very well, this old man agrees.'

At the very moment this fragile understanding was reached, the sky suddenly tore open, and countless demonic shadows poured forth from a black crack. Ye Qing's eyes flashed with cold light, her Demonic Path mist rapidly expanding to shield Chen Ji. 'Chen Ji, be careful!' she hissed, her demonic sword already unsheathed. Yet the enemy came too swiftly—a black strand of demonic energy slipped past Ye Qing's defenses like a venomous snake, striking directly toward Chen Ji's throat.

Ye Qing's figure flashed, blocking before Chen Ji. Her demonic sword swept horizontally, shattering that black demonic energy, yet another demonic shadow seized the opening, striking Ye Qing's back with a palm. Blood trickled from the corner of her mouth, yet she remained firmly planted before Chen Ji, not retreating a single step. Chen Ji stared at that bloodstain, feeling something in his heart suddenly surge violently—this was the first time he had felt moved for an ally's safety.

Chen Ji grabbed Ye Qing's shoulder, and for the first time, that perpetually composed face displayed an impossible-to-hide anxiety and heartache. Ye Qing leaned against his chest, her pale face bearing a weak yet tender smile. 'Don't... don't look at me like that. I'm the Demonic Path Saint, not so easily killed.' Her voice was soft, yet carried undeniable resolve. Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, then suddenly spoke, his tone low and serious.

dialogue.content: 'Ye Qing, there's something I must tell you. The Tianji Record has foretold my death—in three months, I will be obliterated by the Heavenly Eye.'

choice.prompt: How would Ye Qing respond to Chen Ji's confession?

choices.text: Express firm resolve, vow to break fate
choices.description: Ye Qing declares she will stand by Chen Ji's side no matter what, even if it means opposing Heaven
choices.visible_reward: Deepen the bond with Ye Qing, unlock the 'Shared Destiny' contract prerequisite
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Eye may consequently target Ye Qing

dialogue.content: Ye Qing's gaze showed not the slightest waver, instead revealing a desperate resolve. 'The Heavenly Eye? Hmph, in this life of mine, I never believed in any destiny.' She wiped the blood from the corner of her mouth, her voice weak yet sonorous, 'You once saved my life, now it's my turn to protect you. Whatever happens, I stand by your side.'

choices.text: Analyze rationally, seek a way to break the situation
choices.description: Ye Qing calms down, proposes that the two of them research how to counter the Heavenly Eye's prophecy together
choices.visible_reward: Gain Ye Qing's strategic support, unlock the 'Fate Discussion' side quest
choices.risk_hint: May miss the optimal timing for action

dialogue.content: Ye Qing took a deep breath, suppressing her surging emotions. 'Don't be too moved yet, we must find a solution.' She gazed into Chen Ji's eyes, 'If the Tianji Record could foretell death, it must also have foretold a way to break it. Tell me more details, we'll find it together.'

choices.memory_label: 夜清提议共同研究命运

text.content: Chen Ji gazed at Ye Qing's resolute expression, feeling an indescribable warmth surge in his heart. Yet just then, his brow center suddenly传来一阵剧烈的刺痛—that was the signal of a bloodline connection being forcibly activated. Chen Nian! His younger sister, that child taken by the Holy Sect to serve as a 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key', was at this moment transmitting a vague yet urgent message through the bloodline: family crisis, Su Qingyao trapped.

Chen Ji's expression dramatically changed—that always strategically composed face now displayed an unprecedented gravity. Su Qingyao, that woman who had always tried to uncover his secrets, was also an indispensable piece in his secret schemes. Now she was trapped in some Ancient Forbidden Land, her life uncertain. And the alliance he had just reached with the Demonic Path Commander—he must choose between the Imperial Capital and the Forbidden Land. Chen Ji closed his eyes, drew a deep breath, and upon reopening them, his gaze held only utter determination.

choice.prompt: Chen Ji must make a choice—stay in the Imperial Capital to continue dealing with the Demonic Path, or go to the Forbidden Land to rescue Su Qingyao?

choices.text: Abandon the Imperial Capital, immediately head to the Forbidden Land to rescue Su Qingyao
choices.description: Su Qingyao is his important ally and friend, cannot stand by indifferently
choices.visible_cost: Lose advantage in the Imperial Capital layout, may offend the Demonic Path
choices.visible_reward: Su Qingyao's affection increases significantly, may unlock deep bond
choices.risk_hint: The Demonic Path Commander may consider him to have broken the agreement

text.content: 'Ye Qing, come with me.' Chen Ji didn't hesitate for a moment, gathering Ye Qing into his arms and transforming into a streak of light streaking toward the Forbidden Land. Behind them, the Demonic Path Commander coldly huffed yet didn't pursue—with the great plan of the Convergence of Three Realms at stake, he wasn't pressed for this moment. Ye Qing leaned in Chen Ji's embrace, weak yet smiling: 'You... fool.'

choices.text: Send someone to rescue, personally stay in the Imperial Capital to continue layout
choices.description: Don't go personally, but mobilize resources to arrange a rescue operation
choices.visible_cost: May not arrive in time to save Su Qingyao
choices.visible_reward: Maintain advantage in the Imperial Capital layout, demonstrate strategic acumen

text.content: Chen Ji deliberated briefly, quickly making his decision. 'Ye Qing, return to the Holy Sect first to gather reinforcements. I have something more important to do here in the Imperial Capital.' He wrote a letter, ordering it to be sent to the Forbidden Land at maximum speed. Yet Ye Qing shook her head: 'Let me go. I know the Forbidden Land, and I have the ability to rescue her.' She stood up, her wounds still bleeding, yet her gaze was unwavering.

choices.memory_label: 陈机委托夜清营救苏青瑶

text.content: Ye Qing departed bearing Chen Ji's letter, her wounds unhealed yet her steps firm as iron. Chen Ji gazed at her retreating figure, his heart filled with mixed emotions. He clenched his fist, murmuring softly, 'Su Qingyao, you hold on for me.' Before his words even faded, the Tianji Record burned hot once more—the existence known as the 'Heavenly Eye' was gazing upon him through the cracks of fate. Chen Ji felt an invisible pressure envelop his entire body, as if a pair of unseen eyes were prying into everything about him.

He drew a deep breath, raised his head toward the sky, a hint of mockery flickering in his gaze. So what if there's a Heavenly Eye? Since Chen Ji dared to grasp the Tianji Record as a mortal, he had long prepared to struggle against Heaven. Yet at this moment, he became even more convinced of one thing—whether Su Qingyao, Ye Qing, or Chen Nian, those around him, could not be lost. Night fell, the lights of the Imperial Capital flickering in the distance, Chen Ji stood alone in the wind, his silhouette lonely yet upright as a pine.

From afar came rumbling thunder—that was the precursor of the Convergence of Three Realms about to open. And from even farther away, Ye Qing was carrying his entrustment, rushing toward that Forbidden Land of uncertain fate. Chen Ji closed his eyes, and in his mind surfaced Su Qingyao's cold yet stubborn face, along with her persistence when she had thrice come infinitely close to the truth. 'Wait for me.' he silently said, 'This time, it's my turn to protect you.' The Heavenly Fate Mark in his palm剧烈跳动，仿佛在回应他的决心。

Meanwhile, deep within an Ancient Forbidden Land, Su Qingyao was trapped by countless formations, yet in this desperate situation she maintained her composure. She sensed Chen Ji's bloodline connection, and a faint smile appeared at the corner of her lips. 'Chen Ji, you truly are extraordinary.' Her eyes shimmered with peculiar light, 'This time, let me see, how will you ultimately choose?' Outside the formations, fierce beasts' howls echoed. Between life and death, Su Qingyao was extraordinarily calm—because she knew, that 'Waste' would definitely come.
